find: if (held && isTargetable(world, tank, held)) return held;
replace: if (false && held && isTargetable(world, tank, held)) return held;
why: The committed id must be READ BACK, not merely written. Skipping straight to the pure fallback leaves commitTarget writing state nothing consumes, so an AI would re-select every tick and 'movement and firing use the same committed opponent' would hold only by the fallback's determinism -- until the first selection input a decision can mutate.
killedBy: resolveOpponent: the one place an AI decides who it is fighting (issue #359) prefers the COMMITTED target over anything the fallback would pick
